includedPullRequests.title: feat(settings-test): Show a test's checks and steps before it can start
includedPullRequests.body:
Every settings test's row in the hub now opens, even while another test runs, so you can read what a test needs and how it goes before you can start it. Starting is still up to its Check screen. With another test running, that screen's first blocker now names that test. It used to say to switch out of Basal Testing, which would have ended the running test. **See the steps** under the Check screen's header opens a sheet with every step. Carb Ratio stays closed while it's rebuilt.

![Hub while the basal test runs, before and after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6f5b872-6d11-4dac-ac76-2c4b9997942f) ![ISF Check while the basal test runs, before and after, and its steps sheet](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/76f3bb28-0f01-4f78-8fe6-71dfa451736a)

An old result reached this way doesn't offer the basal or ISF editor while the other test runs, and doesn't say the usual mode is back while Basal Testing is on.

Tested with the full unit suite and rendered before and after on iOS 27.2 (SE, 17 Pro), 18.0 (SE, 16 Pro) and 26.0 with Liquid Glass off (SE, 17 Pro), at five text sizes and Display Zoom.
